An enchanted iron shoe that bends luck in your favor. Equips in the Feet or Charm curio slot to grant a chance to completely negate fall damage.

§6Discovery & Tiers§r
Found in buried treasure, dungeons, desert temples, mineshafts, and shipwrecks. Can be reforged into higher tiers at a crafting table:
• §fTier 1 (Iron):§r §a50%§r fall damage negation
• §aTier 2 (Emerald):§r §a75%§r fall damage negation
• §bTier 3 (Diamond):§r §a90%§r fall damage negation
• §5Tier 4 (Netherite):§r §6100%§r fall damage immunity

§6Reforging at the Crafting Table§r
Surround any tier horseshoe with 8 upgrade materials:
• §a8 Emeralds:§r Tier 2 (75% negation)
• §b8 Diamonds:§r Tier 3 (90% negation)
• §58 Netherite Ingots:§r Tier 4 (100% immunity)

Any tier can be directly upgraded into a higher tier.
